appLocalizations.name: DY Guitar Class - A chord dictionary and rhythm
appLocalizations.description:
This app is available for free.
If you find it useful or like it, please buy me a cup of coffee.
https://buymeacoffee.com/alex.kim


A watch app for people learning the guitar. The screen looks like a guitar soundhole: pick the root (C, D, E ...) on the outer dial and the chord type (m, 7, maj7 ...) on the inner dial, and the chord diagram shows which fret and finger to use. Strumming patterns are practised by feeling the beat as wrist vibrations. This app was made for my beloved son DY.

**Features**
- **Chord dictionary:** 144 chords (12 roots x 12 types) with up to 4 shapes each (open, root on the 6th string, root on the 5th string ...). Diagrams show finger numbers, fret numbers, barres, muted strings and the root, plus the note of every string and the chord tones. Difficulty in 5 stars.
- **Flat names from song sheets:** Db Eb Gb Ab Bb sit in the same cells as their sharp names, so a Bbm on a song sheet is the A# (Bb) cell.
- **Strumming by vibration:** 14 patterns including 4-beat, 8-beat, 16-beat, waltz, folk, go-go, calypso, shuffle and slow rock. The screen shows rhythm notation with down, up and accent marks; the watch buzzes strongest on the first beat of a bar, strong on accents and light on the rest.
- **Practice:** up to 4 chords changing every n bars, a count-in, a double tap before the next chord, and automatic tempo increase (+5 BPM every 4 bars up to a target).
- **Chord sets:** 9 beginner sets such as the first three chords (G C D), pop four chords, the fifties progression and minor basics, plus chords by key (G key gives G C D Em).
- **Capo helper:** pick the key of a song and it finds capo positions with the fewest barre chords, for example Eb = capo 1 with D G A Bm. The shapes go straight into practice.
- **1-minute changes:** change between two chords for 60 seconds and record how many changes you made, the drill guitar teachers recommend most. Your best is kept for each pair.
- **5 soundhole themes:** Acoustic, Sunburst, Classical, Midnight and a red padauk inlay rosette (default).
- **Left-hand mode:** mirrored diagrams. Three vibration strengths.
- Help with figures and tables (reading diagrams, reading rhythm, capo and keys, terms). 8 languages: English, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified).

**Supported watches:** 55 five-button watches (Forerunner 165 / 170 / 255 / 265 / 570 / 955 / 965 / 970, fenix 7 / 8 / 9, epix 2, Enduro 3 / 4, Instinct 3 AMOLED, MARQ, D2, Descent and more). Touch-only Venu and vivoactive watches are not supported.

Works offline, free with no ads. If it helps you, you can buy me a coffee from Donate, the first item in the menu.

appLocalizations.name: DY 기타교실 - 손목 위의 코드 사전과 리듬 선생님
appLocalizations.description:
이 앱은 무료로 제공됩니다.
유용하거나 마음에 드신다면 커피 한 잔 사주시면 감사하겠습니다.
https://buymeacoffee.com/alex.kim



기타를 처음 배우는 사람을 위한 워치 앱입니다. 화면은 기타의 사운드홀처럼 생겼고, 바깥 다이얼에서 루트 (C, D, E ...), 안쪽 다이얼에서 코드 타입 (m, 7, maj7 ...) 을 고르면 어디를 어느 손가락으로 잡는지 코드 그림이 바로 나옵니다. 주법은 손목 진동으로 박자를 느끼며 연습합니다. 이 앱은 사랑하는 아들 DY를 위해 만들었습니다.

**주요 기능**
- **코드 사전:** 코드 144개 (12 루트 x 12 타입), 코드마다 모양 최대 4가지 (개방 코드, 6번 줄 루트, 5번 줄 루트 ...). 코드 그림에는 손가락 번호, 프렛 번호, 바레, 뮤트 줄, 루트 음 표시가 있고 줄마다 나는 음과 구성음도 보여 줍니다. 쉬운 정도는 별 5개로.
- **악보의 플랫 코드도 그대로:** Db Eb Gb Ab Bb 는 같은 칸에 샵 이름과 함께 적혀 있어서, 악보에 Bbm 이 있으면 A# (Bb) 칸을 고르면 됩니다.
- **진동으로 익히는 주법:** 4비트, 8비트, 16비트, 왈츠, 포크 패턴, 고고, 칼립소, 셔플, 슬로우 록 등 14가지. 화면에는 다운, 업, 악센트가 표시된 리듬 악보가 나오고, 손목은 마디 첫 박을 가장 세게, 악센트를 세게, 나머지를 약하게 진동합니다.
- **연습:** 코드 최대 4개를 정해 n 마디마다 바꾸고, 카운트인, 다음 코드 예고 (두 번 짧은 진동), 템포 자동 올리기 (4마디마다 +5 BPM, 목표까지).
- **연습 코드 세트:** 첫 세 코드 (G C D), 팝 4코드, 50년대 진행, 단조 기본 등 초보자용 9가지와 키별 코드 (G 키를 고르면 G C D Em).
- **카포 도우미:** 노래 키를 고르면 바레 코드가 적은 카포 자리를 찾아 줍니다. 예: Eb 키 = 카포 1 + D G A Bm. 고른 모양은 바로 연습에 담깁니다.
- **1분 체인지:** 두 코드를 60초 동안 번갈아 잡고 바꾼 횟수를 기록하는, 교본에서 가장 많이 권하는 코드 전환 연습. 짝마다 최고 기록이 남습니다.
- **사운드홀 테마 5가지:** 어쿠스틱, 선버스트, 클래식, 미드나이트, 붉은 파두크 상감 로제트 (기본).
- **왼손 모드:** 코드 그림 좌우 반전. 진동 세기 3단계.
- 그림과 표로 설명하는 도움말 (코드 그림 읽기, 리듬 읽기, 카포와 키, 용어). 8개 언어: 한국어, English, Deutsch, Français, Español, 日本語, 繁體中文, 简体中文.

**지원 워치:** 버튼 5개 워치 55종 (Forerunner 165 / 170 / 255 / 265 / 570 / 955 / 965 / 970, fenix 7 / 8 / 9, epix 2, Enduro 3 / 4, Instinct 3 AMOLED, MARQ, D2, Descent 등). 화면 터치만 있는 Venu, vivoactive 는 지원하지 않습니다.

인터넷 없이 동작하고, 광고 없이 무료입니다. 도움이 되셨다면 메뉴 첫 줄 '기부하기' 에서 커피 한 잔으로 응원해 주세요.

appLocalizations.name: Interval Timer HR
appLocalizations.description:
Simple interval timer with heart rate for Garmin watches.

- Set work (10 seconds up to 25 minutes), rest (5 seconds up to 3 minutes) and up to 99 rounds, for example Tabata.
- 5-second get-ready countdown with beeps.
- Clear signals: strong vibration and tone for work, double signal for rest, melody at the end.
- Big timer with a white bar during work, readable at a glance.
- Live heart rate in the round Instinct subscreen.
- Summary: rounds, total time, average and maximum heart rate.
- Saved to Garmin Connect with a lap for every work and rest phase.

All features are free.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: All features unlocked: work up to 25 minutes, rest up to 3 minutes, up to 99 rounds, maximum heart rate.

appLocalizations.name: Ćwiczenia interwałowe
appLocalizations.description:
Prosty minutnik interwałowy z tętnem na zegarki Garmin.

- Ustaw pracę (od 10 sekund do 25 minut), przerwę (od 5 sekund do 3 minut) i do 99 rund, np. Tabata.
- 5 sekund na przygotowanie z krótkimi sygnałami.
- Wyraźne sygnały: mocna wibracja i dźwięk na pracę, podwójny sygnał na przerwę, melodia na koniec.
- Duży czas na białym pasku w trakcie pracy, czytelny z daleka.
- Tętno na żywo w okrągłym okienku Instinct.
- Podsumowanie: rundy, łączny czas oraz tętno średnie i maksymalne.
- Zapis do Garmin Connect z okrążeniem na każdą fazę pracy i przerwy.

Wszystkie funkcje są darmowe.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: Wszystkie funkcje odblokowane: praca do 25 minut, przerwa do 3 minut, do 99 rund, tętno maksymalne.

appLocalizations.name: Pulse Meditation
appLocalizations.description:
Calm, silent meditation timer for Garmin watches.

- Choose a session from 1 minute up to 90 minutes.
- Press START: a silent 5-second countdown, then one vibration and the session begins.
- No sounds at all: start, pause and end are signalled by vibration only.
- Live heart rate in the round Instinct subscreen.
- Stress and Body Battery before and after the session.
- Summary: time, average, minimum and maximum heart rate.
- Saved to Garmin Connect as an activity.

All features are free.

Not a medical device.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: All features unlocked: sessions up to 90 minutes, stress and Body Battery, heart-rate min and max.

appLocalizations.name: Medytacja
appLocalizations.description:
Spokojny, cichy minutnik do medytacji na zegarki Garmin.

- Wybierz sesję od 1 minuty do 90 minut.
- Naciśnij START: 5 sekund cichego odliczania, potem jedna wibracja i start.
- Zero dźwięków: start, pauza i koniec sygnalizowane tylko wibracją.
- Tętno na żywo w okrągłym okienku Instinct.
- Stres i Body Battery przed i po sesji.
- Podsumowanie: czas oraz tętno średnie, minimalne i maksymalne.
- Zapis do Garmin Connect jako aktywność.

Wszystkie funkcje są darmowe.

To nie jest wyrób medyczny.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: Wszystkie funkcje odblokowane: sesje do 90 minut, stres i Body Battery, tętno min i max.

appLocalizations.name: Coherence Meditation
appLocalizations.description:
Coherence Meditation is a breathing app that shows you, live, how your heart responds to your breath. It reads the beat-to-beat rhythm of your optical heart sensor and turns it into a coherence score you can watch settle as you slow down.

LIVE BIOFEEDBACK
• A breathing circle grows on the inhale and shrinks on the exhale. Its colour shows your heart-breath coherence in real time: grey while measuring, then orange, yellow and green as your heart rhythm locks onto your breath.
• Heart rate, breathing rate and a 0-100 coherence score on one screen.
• Your current heart rate zone, measured against your own resting heart rate: Deep calm, Relaxation, Settling, Activated.

BREATHING PATTERNS
• Even breathing, long exhale (4:6), box breathing (4-4-4-4), 4-7-8, or free mode with no guidance at all.
• Tempo from 4.0 to 8.0 breaths per minute.
• Optional gentle vibration on every inhale and exhale, and an optional end tone. Both can be switched off, so nothing buzzes or beeps if you prefer silence.

FIND YOUR OWN BREATHING RATE
A guided test walks you through six tempi, two minutes each, and picks the one where your coherence was highest. It is saved as your pacer rate.

AFTER EVERY SESSION
A three-page summary:
• Time, average heart rate, average coherence, breathing rate, HRV (RMSSD) and the share of the session spent in deep calm.
• A graph of heart rate and coherence over the session, and how long it took you to settle.
• Time in each heart rate zone, HRV at the start versus the end, and the change in Body Battery and stress.
The session is saved as an activity and syncs to Garmin Connect.

HISTORY
Your last 30 sessions: sessions and minutes this week, a streak of days in a row, and a bar for the coherence of every session.

LEARN
Short pages, right on the watch: heart rate zones, HRV and coherence, and breathing and the nervous system.

CONTROLS
• START: begin, pause, resume
• DOWN on the home screen: menu (History, Find my rate, Learn, Settings)
• UP / DOWN on the summary: pages
• BACK during a session: resume, save or discard
• MENU (hold UP): settings

LANGUAGES
The app follows the language of your watch: English, Slovak, Czech, German, Polish, Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese. On watches set to any other language it appears in English.

NOTE
Coherence Meditation is a practice aid, not a medical device, and makes no health or therapeutic claims. Coherence, HRV and breathing figures come from the optical heart sensor, an indirect measure.

Free to try for 24 hours. After the trial the app shows an activation code: go to kzl.io/code, enter it and complete the one-time purchase. The app unlocks automatically within a minute, the next time your watch syncs. One purchase, no ads, no subscription.

appLocalizations.name: Adagio Running
appLocalizations.description:
Adagio shows your running cadence (steps per minute) live on your wrist and records your run with GPS.

ON THE WATCH
• Live cadence in big, glanceable numbers
• Pace in minutes per mile or per km
• "Waiting for GPS" until your position is locked
• Saves your run to Garmin Connect as "Run with Adagio", with GPS route, distance and pace. If Garmin Connect is linked to Strava, it's sent there too.
• When you finish: Save, Discard or Resume. Runs under one minute are discarded automatically.

WITH THE ADAGIO RUNNING IPHONE APP
• Picks songs from your Apple Music playlists that match your target cadence (or run without music)
• Shows your target cadence and target pace on the watch, in green when you're on target and red when you're off
• Spoken coaching cues when you drift off target
• Pulse Mode: vibration cues on the watch (two taps = speed up, one long buzz = slow down) and a full-screen colour change (blue = speed up, orange = slow down), so you can follow your cadence without sound
• Start from your phone: the watch asks to open Adagio. End from your phone: the watch saves the run.

REQUIREMENTS
• A compatible Garmin watch, paired with the Garmin Connect app
• For music, targets and coaching: the Adagio Running app for iPhone (coming soon to the App Store)
• GPS features need an outdoor view of the sky

PERMISSIONS
• Location (GPS): records your route, distance and pace during a run
• Fitness recording: saves your run to Garmin Connect
• Communication: exchanges live cadence and targets with the Adagio Running iPhone app

Support: adagiorunning.support@gmail.com · https://adagio-darren.onrender.com/support
Privacy: https://adagio-darren.onrender.com/privacy
appLocalizations.whatsNew: First release

appLocalizations.name: Hybrid Workout
appLocalizations.description:
Hybrid Workout times indoor hybrid races and training on compatible Garmin watches. Pick a HYROX or DEKA FIT course, or build and name your own sequence of runs, stations, and transitions. Save up to three setups on your watch.

- Set a distance for each run and a target time in minutes and seconds for each segment.
- Choose separately whether to record transitions after runs and after stations as their own laps. Set transition targets for each round. HYROX displays these segments as Roxzone during the workout.
- Preview the course on the start screen. During the workout, see segment time, target difference, total time, time ahead of or behind plan, and heart rate when available.
- Press LAP to advance. Press DOWN within five seconds to undo an accidental switch.
- Save your workout as an Indoor Track activity on supported watches and review your splits on the watch.

The indoor timer uses the course distances you enter. English is the default. To switch to Korean, press UP and select Language, then Korean. Hybrid Workout is an independently developed app.
appLocalizations.whatsNew:
- Press DOWN within five seconds to undo an accidental segment switch.
- Set post-run and post-station transition targets for each round. HYROX displays Roxzone during the workout.
- Save as Indoor Track on supported watches. Distance, average heart rate, and calories are recorded when the watch provides them.
- Updated the app icon.

appLocalizations.name: 하이브리드 운동
appLocalizations.description:
가민 워치에서 실내 하이브리드 레이스와 훈련의 구간 시간을 기록하세요. 하이록스나 데카 핏 기본 코스를 불러오거나, 러닝·스테이션·트랜지션을 원하는 순서로 구성하고 이름을 붙일 수 있습니다. 워치에 운동 세팅을 세 개까지 저장할 수 있습니다.

- 라운드별 러닝 거리를 바꾸고 각 구간의 목표 시간을 분과 초 단위로 설정하세요.
- 러닝 후와 스테이션 후 트랜지션을 별도 랩으로 기록할지 각각 선택하고 라운드별 목표 시간을 설정하세요. 하이록스 운동 중에는 이 구간이 록스존으로 표시됩니다.
- 시작 화면에서 코스 순서를 확인하세요. 운동 중에는 구간 시간, 목표 시간과의 차이, 총 시간, 계획 대비 앞서거나 늦은 시간, 측정 가능한 경우 현재 심박을 볼 수 있습니다.
- LAP을 눌러 다음 구간으로 넘어가세요. 잘못 눌렀다면 5초 안에 DOWN을 눌러 되돌릴 수 있습니다.
- 지원 워치에서 운동을 실내 트랙 활동으로 저장하고 구간별 기록을 확인하세요.

실내 타이머는 입력한 코스 거리를 사용합니다. 기본 언어는 영어입니다. UP을 누르고 Language에서 Korean을 선택하면 한국어로 바뀝니다. 독립 개발 앱입니다.
appLocalizations.whatsNew:
- 구간을 잘못 넘겼다면 5초 안에 DOWN을 눌러 되돌릴 수 있습니다.
- 라운드별로 러닝 후와 스테이션 후 트랜지션 목표 시간을 설정할 수 있습니다. 하이록스 운동 화면에는 록스존으로 표시됩니다.
- 지원 워치에서는 실내 트랙 활동으로 저장합니다. 워치에서 측정값을 제공하면 거리·평균 심박수·칼로리가 기록됩니다.
- 앱 아이콘을 바꿨습니다.

appLocalizations.name: Solxce: HYROX, Run, HIIT & Swim
appLocalizations.description:
Train like a hybrid athlete. Solxce brings the Solxce app's workouts to your Garmin watch: HYROX race splits, GPS runs, intervals, HIIT, pool swims and lifting, all in one app, synced to the Solxce iPhone app.

HYROX RACE
Race all 8 runs and 8 stations with Roxzone transitions. Press LAP (or tap) after each segment for a split on every run, station and transition. Segment time, total time, heart rate with your zone, and live run pace stay on screen, with the next segment shown on the button. See the full breakdown (running, stations, Roxzone and every split) as soon as you cross the line.

RUN
GPS run tracking with time, distance, current pace, heart rate and laps, in miles or kilometres.

INTERVALS
Ring-countdown interval runs with warm up and cool down: 400m Repeats, Tempo 20, Hill Sprints and Mile Repeats. The watch buzzes at every change.

HIIT
Tabata, 30/30 Burner, EMOM 12 and Full-Body Circuit, with each exercise named on screen, a Get Ready countdown, round count and what's next.

SWIM
Pool swims for 25 yd, 25 m and 50 m pools. Press LAP at each wall to count laps, with times for this lap and your last lap. START rests between sets. Finish with distance, pace per 100 and every lap time.

LIFT
Log sets, reps and weight for your main lifts. Solxce keeps your personal records on the watch and tells you the moment you hit a new one.

SYNC TO SOLXCE
Link your watch once with a 6-digit code from Settings, then Garmin in the Solxce iPhone app. Every workout you finish then uploads to your Solxce account through your phone, with the route map and heart rate, and counts toward your weekly miles and challenges.

Every workout also saves as a Garmin activity and syncs to Garmin Connect.

Get the full Solxce experience on iPhone, with nutrition, meal scanning, friend challenges and the community feed.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: Link your watch to the Solxce iPhone app: open Settings, then Garmin on your iPhone, tap Link Garmin Watch, then enter the 6-digit code under Link Account on your watch. Your runs and workouts then sync to Solxce automatically, with route map and heart rate. Workouts now arrive in the iPhone app with their own names (HYROX, Swim, Lift and more), and a workout finished during an upload is no longer missed.

appLocalizations.name: PrayerReminder — Indonesia Prayer Times
appLocalizations.description:
Prayer times for your selected Indonesian city, on your wrist.

PrayerReminder shows Fajr (Subuh), Dhuhr (Zuhur), Asr (Asar), Maghrib, and Isha for Indonesian cities and regencies. Choose a city in the app settings in Connect IQ, then open PrayerReminder on your watch to update its schedule.

FEATURES
• A selection of 517 Indonesian cities and regencies.
• Download schedules for the current and following month.
• Use saved schedules and reminders offline after a successful sync.
• Countdown to the next prayer, including tomorrow's Fajr after Isha.
• Display time in the selected city's WIB, WITA, or WIT time zone.
• Enable or disable reminders, adjust all times by up to ±15 minutes, and test vibration.
• View the active city and sync status.

GET STARTED
1. Open PrayerReminder settings in Connect IQ, choose a city, and save.
2. Connect your watch to Garmin Connect on your phone. Your phone needs internet during sync.
3. Open PrayerReminder on the watch and wait for “Sync DD/MM HH:mm”.
4. Exit the app to schedule background reminders.

Press START and select “Sync ulang jadwal” to retry. Opening the app starts an update. Changing settings while it is open also starts an update. There are no periodic downloads while the app is closed.

REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITATIONS
• Currently supports the non-Music Forerunner 165 only. The watch interface is in Indonesian. This is a watch app, not a watch face.
• City selection is manual. The app does not use GPS or automatically follow your location.
• Sync needs a phone, Garmin Connect, and internet. Saved schedules work offline.
• A failed sync keeps the previous schedule and its city. Sync again if there is no saved schedule or its coverage has expired.
• Background reminders use Garmin system dialogs. Vibration depends on device behavior and Do Not Disturb settings. No audible adhan is provided.
• Keep the device clock correct. Open and exit the app after restarting the watch.
• When upgrading from the Banjarmasin version, check your existing correction. Set it to 0 minutes to use downloaded times without adjustment.

SCHEDULE SOURCE
Schedules come from myQuran API v3, a third-party service that identifies Bimas Islam Kemenag as its data source. PrayerReminder is not an official Garmin or Kemenag app. Data availability depends on that service. Compare times with your local reference before use.
https://api.myquran.com/doc
appLocalizations.whatsNew:
Fixed prayer reminders while the app is closed.

• Initialize schedule sync only when the watch app screen opens.
• Fix a background startup crash that prevented prayer reminder dialogs.
• Keep downloaded schedules and the existing sync workflow.

After updating, open PrayerReminder, confirm a schedule is available and reminders are enabled, then exit the app to register the next reminder.

appLocalizations.name: HoopTracker Lite
appLocalizations.description:
**Name:** HoopTracker Lite

**Short description:** Track your basketball shooting: makes, misses and live %, in games, free shooting and zone routines, with stats in Garmin Connect.

**Description:**

HoopTracker Lite turns your Forerunner into a basketball shot tracker. Tap a button for every shot and see your shooting percentage live. Each session is saved as a Basketball activity with your shooting stats in Garmin Connect.

GAME
- Start = make, Back = miss, Up = undo the last shot
- Live shooting %, makes/attempts, elapsed time and heart rate coloured by zone
- Down switches between the counter and a big clock page
- Double presses within 1.2 s are ignored, so a nervous thumb doesn't count twice
- Hold Up for the menu: Save, Pause/Resume, Cancel or Discard

FREE SHOOTING
- The same counter for shooting on your own, recorded as an exercise session

ROUTINES
- Three ready-made routines (Basic, Threes and Timed) and an on-watch editor to create, edit and delete your own
- Each step has a court zone (paint, mid-range, corners, wings, top of the key, free throw), a number of shots, a mode (shots, makes or makes in a row), sets, rest between sets, an optional time limit, a goal % and rounds
- Vibration at the end of each set and when you change position, and a rest countdown
- Automatic shot detection (beta): the watch detects your shooting motion and asks "MADE IT?". Start = yes, Back = no, Up = false detection. If you don't answer, it counts as a miss. You can always mark shots by hand.
- Detection sensitivity is adjustable (low / medium / high)

SUMMARY AND HISTORY
- End-of-session summary: %, makes/attempts, time, best streak, average heart rate and calories, plus a per-step breakdown for routines
- History of your last 30 sessions on the watch

GARMIN CONNECT
- Saved as a Basketball activity (Game or Exercise sub-sport), with heart rate, calories and steps
- Custom fields: makes, misses, attempts, shooting %, best streak, steps and detected shots
- Shooting % chart over time
- In routines, one lap per set, with its zone, makes, attempts and %

Designed for the Forerunner 945 LTE screen: large high-contrast numbers that are easy to read on the move, and buttons only (no touch screen needed with sweaty hands).

Permissions: Sensor (shot detection), Fit (record the activity), User Profile (heart rate zones).

**What's new (1.0.0):** First release for the Forerunner 945 LTE.

appLocalizations.name: Cycle – Period Tracker
appLocalizations.description:
Your period, on your wrist – and only there.

Cycle is a complete period tracker that lives on your watch. Everything you log stays on the watch: no account, no cloud, no phone app to open.

YOUR CYCLE AT A GLANCE
• A ring with a segment for every day of your cycle: period in rose, fertile window in teal, today a white dot
• In the middle: your cycle day and what comes next – "Period in 9 days", "Fertile window", "Period · day 3", "Period 4 days late"
• A glance with the same, and your cycle as a bar

CALENDAR
The month at a glance: logged period days, predicted ones, the fertile window and ovulation, and a dot on days you logged something else. Pick any day to log or change it.

LOG EVERYTHING, IN A FEW TAPS
• Period: spotting, light, medium or heavy flow on a picker of drops; clots; pads, liners, tampons, cups, discs and period underwear. Spotting isn't counted as a period unless you say so.
• Mood: calm, stressed, unmotivated, sad, happy, irritable, angry, energetic, horny
• Symptoms: acne, bloating, cramps, cravings, discharge, fatigue, fever, headache, itchiness, nausea, severe pain, stomachache, tender chest, ovulation pain
• Sex: protection from STIs and pregnancy, and more
• Contraception: pill (taken, missed, double), IUD, implant, patch, ring, shot, condom, diaphragm, cervical cap, sponge, spermicide, pull out, emergency contraception
• Tests: STI and pregnancy, positive or negative

PREDICTIONS THAT LEARN
Your next period from the average of your last six cycles (newer ones count more); ovulation and the fertile window from your luteal phase. Until you have logged a cycle, Cycle uses the lengths you give it when you set it up.

SUMMARY, HISTORY AND PATTERNS
• Average cycle and period length, and how much your cycles vary
• Your last six cycles as bars
• Patterns: what you log most in the days before your period and during it – "Cramps · 6 of 6"

REMINDERS
Your period coming (two days before), late, the fertile window starting, your pill every day (skipping the break week of your pack), and logging your flow in the evening. Each one can be turned off.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything you log is stored only on your watch
• Discreet mode: the glance and reminders show no details
• Auto-delete everything every week, month or three months – or delete it all now
• Hide the fertile window if you don't want it

GOOD TO KNOW
• Predictions are estimates. Cycle is not birth control: don't rely on it to avoid pregnancy.
• Cycle is not medical advice. See a clinician about changes in your cycle.

PRIVACY
No accounts or advertising. Nothing you log ever leaves your watch. Once per launch the app sends an anonymous usage count: the watch ID this app sees (stored only as a one-way hash), the watch model, firmware and app version.

This is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin.

AllMySat: Satellite Tracker
appLocalizations.description:
AllMySat for Garmin brings your satellite passes to your wrist. It works with the AllMySat app on your phone, which computes the passes and sends them to the watch. The watch then follows them on its own, even without the phone.

Before a pass: countdown, elevation curve with the max elevation, start and end times and directions.

During a pass: elevation and azimuth, a compass to point at the satellite (it turns green when you face it), the frequency to tune, and the Doppler steps on an arc in your app’s colors, with the next frequency announced before each change.

Also: pass list, glance with the elevation curve, the next pass on your watch face (complication, on compatible watches and faces), vibrations at the key moments of the pass. In night mode, the app turns red with the rest of your watch.

Requires the AllMySat app on iPhone.

appLocalizations.name: Coffee Log
appLocalizations.description:
Caffeine leaves your body slowly: about half of it is still there 5 hours later. Coffee Log works out how much is in you right now, from every drink you log, and tells you when it will be low enough to sleep.

TWO RINGS
• The outer ring: caffeine in your body now, rising as a drink kicks in and falling as your body clears it
• The inner ring: everything you've had today, against your daily limit (400 mg by default)
• In the middle: the mg in your body, and "Sleep-ready 10:20 pm" – green before your bedtime, orange after

LAST CALL
Coffee Log knows your bedtime (from your watch's sleep settings, or set your own) and tells you the latest time your usual drink still lets you sleep: "Last coffee by 3:40 pm". Turn on the alert and the watch reminds you 15 minutes before – only on days you've had caffeine.

THE NEXT 12 HOURS
A curve of the caffeine in you from two hours ago to bedtime, with the sleep line and a moon at bedtime. The dashed line shows what one more cup now would do.

ONE TAP
Press SELECT, then SELECT again: your usual drink is logged, with a buzz and the rings sweeping up. Espresso, coffee, latte, cold brew, black and green tea, cola, energy drinks, caffeine gels and pills, or a custom amount – each with its own caffeine, which you can change. Forgot one? Log it 15 minutes to 4 hours back, or at any time.

TODAY AND THE WEEK
Today's drinks, with their times (change or delete any of them), and the last 7 days as bars against your limit.

MADE FOR YOU
• Half-life from 3 to 10 hours: shorter for smokers, longer with the pill or in pregnancy
• Your sleep-ready level (25 to 100 mg), daily limit and bedtime
• A day that starts at 4:00, so a late night counts for the day before
• Absorption: caffeine rises over about 45 minutes, as in your body (or count it at once)

GLANCE
When you're sleep-ready, the caffeine in you and a bar, in the glance loop (on watches that show glances for apps).

GOOD TO KNOW
• Everything is stored on the watch; nothing is sent to Garmin Connect or anywhere else.
• The numbers are an estimate from a standard model of how caffeine is absorbed and cleared. People differ a lot: if you sleep badly with "Sleep-ready" in green, lower the sleep-ready level or raise the half-life.
• Coffee Log is not medical advice.

PRIVACY
No accounts or advertising. What you drink stays on your watch. Once per launch the app sends an anonymous usage count: the watch ID this app sees (stored only as a one-way hash), the watch model, firmware and app version.

This is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin.

appLocalizations.name: Domora - Remote for Home Assistant
appLocalizations.description:
Domora is a remote control for Home Assistant on your watch. Your favorite devices are one tap away: lights, switches, thermostat, covers, locks, media players, scenes and sensors.

There is no file to write and no group to add to configuration.yaml. You scan a QR code on the watch with your phone, log in to your Home Assistant, and the watch is connected. Then you choose your favorites on the watch itself, by room or by kind. A built-in demo home lets you try everything first.

WHAT IT DOES
- Favorites page with large buttons; a lit button means the device is on. The top favorite is extra large: open the app and tap once
- Pick favorites on the watch by area or by kind, reorder them and remove them, all without a config file
- Areas page: every room in your home with its devices, loaded a few at a time so large homes work too
- Scenes page: your scenes and scripts, found automatically
- Sensors page and a glance with one or two values you choose, refreshed in the background
- Lights with brightness, fans with speed, thermostats with target temperature and mode, covers with open, stop and close, media players with volume, pause and next
- Locks and alarm panels: unlocking and disarming always ask for confirmation
- Also: input booleans, numbers and selects, vacuums, automations and buttons
- The button reacts at once, then Domora reads the real state back from your home
- Opens instantly with the last known state and refreshes while you look
- Clear messages when something is wrong (token refused, HTTPS needed, phone not connected, no answer), each with what to do
- Works with touch and with buttons only
- English, Dutch, German, French and Spanish

HOW TO CONNECT
1. Open Domora on the watch and choose Scan QR code.
2. Scan the code with your phone camera. On the page that opens, enter the address of your Home Assistant and log in there.
3. The watch says Paired. Choose Add favorites and pick your devices.

Prefer to do it by hand? In the Connect IQ app on your phone, open the settings of Domora and enter the https address of your Home Assistant (for example https://my-home.example:8123, a port is fine) and a long-lived access token (Home Assistant: your profile, Security, Long-lived access tokens, Create token).

WHAT IT NEEDS
- Home Assistant 2023.4 or newer, reachable from the internet over HTTPS with a valid certificate (Home Assistant Cloud or your own domain). Plain http and self-signed certificates do not work on Garmin watches
- Your phone nearby with Bluetooth on; the watch reaches your home through the Garmin Connect app
- Privacy: with QR pairing the phone page creates an access token named Domora watch in your Home Assistant and passes it to the watch encrypted. The key is made on the watch, travels only inside the QR code to your phone and never reaches a server. The relay server holds only the encrypted message, for at most 10 minutes, and deletes it as soon as the watch has fetched it. After that the token stays on your watch and is only sent to your own Home Assistant

Domora is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Home Assistant or the Open Home Foundation.

appLocalizations.name: Domora - Bediening voor Home Assistant
appLocalizations.description:
Domora is een afstandsbediening voor Home Assistant op je horloge. Je favoriete apparaten zitten onder één tik: lampen, schakelaars, thermostaat, zonwering, sloten, mediaspelers, scènes en sensoren.

Je hoeft geen bestand te schrijven en geen groep in configuration.yaml te zetten. Je scant met je telefoon een QR-code op het horloge, logt in bij je Home Assistant en het horloge is verbonden. Daarna kies je je favorieten op het horloge zelf, per kamer of per soort. Met het ingebouwde demohuis kun je alles eerst proberen.

WAT HET DOET
- Favorietenpagina met grote knoppen; een verlichte knop betekent dat het apparaat aan staat. De bovenste favoriet is extra groot: app openen en één keer tikken
- Favorieten kiezen op het horloge per gebied of per soort, ordenen en verwijderen, zonder configuratiebestand
- Gebieden: elke kamer met zijn apparaten, in kleine stukjes geladen zodat ook grote huizen werken
- Scènes: je scènes en scripts, vanzelf gevonden
- Sensorenpagina en een glance met één of twee zelfgekozen waarden, op de achtergrond ververst
- Lampen met helderheid, ventilatoren met snelheid, thermostaten met doeltemperatuur en modus, zonwering met open, stop en dicht, mediaspelers met volume, pauze en volgende
- Sloten en alarm: ontgrendelen en uitschakelen vragen altijd om bevestiging
- Ook: input-booleans, getallen en keuzelijsten, stofzuigers, automatiseringen en knoppen
- De knop reageert meteen, daarna leest Domora de echte stand terug uit je huis
- Opent direct met de laatst bekende stand en ververst terwijl je kijkt
- Duidelijke meldingen als er iets mis is (token geweigerd, HTTPS nodig, geen telefoon, geen antwoord), elk met wat je moet doen
- Werkt met aanraking en met alleen knoppen
- Nederlands, Engels, Duits, Frans en Spaans

ZO VERBIND JE
1. Open Domora op het horloge en kies QR-code scannen.
2. Scan de code met de camera van je telefoon. Vul op de pagina die opent het adres van je Home Assistant in en log daar in.
3. Het horloge meldt Gekoppeld. Kies Favorieten kiezen en kies je apparaten.

Liever met de hand? Open in de Connect IQ-app op je telefoon de instellingen van Domora en vul het https-adres van je Home Assistant in (bijvoorbeeld https://mijn-huis.example:8123, een poort mag) en een langlevend toegangstoken (Home Assistant: je profiel, Beveiliging, Langlevende toegangstokens, Token aanmaken).

WAT HET NODIG HEEFT
- Home Assistant 2023.4 of nieuwer, van buitenaf bereikbaar via HTTPS met een geldig certificaat (Home Assistant Cloud of een eigen domein). Gewoon http en zelfondertekende certificaten werken niet op Garmin-horloges
- Je telefoon in de buurt met Bluetooth aan; het horloge bereikt je huis via de Garmin Connect-app
- Privacy: bij koppelen met de QR-code maakt de pagina op je telefoon in je Home Assistant een toegangstoken met de naam Domora watch en geeft dat versleuteld door aan het horloge. De sleutel wordt op het horloge gemaakt, reist alleen in de QR-code naar je telefoon en komt nooit op een server. De doorgeefserver bewaart alleen het versleutelde bericht, hooguit 10 minuten, en wist het zodra het horloge het heeft opgehaald. Daarna blijft het token op je horloge en gaat het alleen naar je eigen Home Assistant

Domora is een onafhankelijke app en is niet verbonden met of goedgekeurd door Home Assistant of de Open Home Foundation.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: Lijsten scrollen nu met de standaard scroll van je horloge. Schakelaars en scènes schakel je direct vanuit de lijst; lampen en ventilatoren openen hun ringscherm. Apparaten, entiteiten of ruimtes met het label "garmin" in Home Assistant staan vanzelf bij Favorieten.

appLocalizations.name: Domora - Fernbedienung für Home Assistant
appLocalizations.description:
Domora ist eine Fernbedienung für Home Assistant auf deiner Uhr. Deine Lieblingsgeräte sind einen Tipp entfernt: Lichter, Schalter, Thermostat, Rollläden, Schlösser, Mediaplayer, Szenen und Sensoren.

Du musst keine Datei schreiben und keine Gruppe in die configuration.yaml eintragen. Du scannst mit dem Telefon einen QR-Code auf der Uhr, meldest dich bei deinem Home Assistant an, und die Uhr ist verbunden. Danach wählst du deine Favoriten direkt auf der Uhr, nach Raum oder nach Art. Mit dem eingebauten Demo-Zuhause kannst du alles erst ausprobieren.

WAS ES KANN
- Favoritenseite mit großen Tasten; eine leuchtende Taste bedeutet, dass das Gerät an ist. Der oberste Favorit ist extra groß: App öffnen und einmal tippen
- Favoriten auf der Uhr nach Bereich oder Art wählen, ordnen und entfernen, ohne Konfigurationsdatei
- Bereiche: jeder Raum mit seinen Geräten, in kleinen Portionen geladen, damit auch große Häuser funktionieren
- Szenen: deine Szenen und Skripte, automatisch gefunden
- Sensorseite und ein Glance mit ein oder zwei selbst gewählten Werten, im Hintergrund aktualisiert
- Lichter mit Helligkeit, Lüfter mit Stufe, Thermostate mit Solltemperatur und Modus, Rollläden mit Öffnen, Stopp und Schließen, Mediaplayer mit Lautstärke, Pause und Weiter
- Schlösser und Alarmanlagen: Entriegeln und Unscharfschalten fragen immer nach
- Außerdem: Input-Booleans, Zahlen und Auswahllisten, Saugroboter, Automationen und Tasten
- Die Taste reagiert sofort, danach liest Domora den echten Zustand aus deinem Zuhause zurück
- Öffnet sofort mit dem letzten bekannten Zustand und aktualisiert, während du hinsiehst
- Klare Meldungen, wenn etwas nicht stimmt (Token abgelehnt, HTTPS nötig, kein Telefon, keine Antwort), jeweils mit dem, was zu tun ist
- Funktioniert mit Touch und nur mit Tasten
- Deutsch, Englisch, Niederländisch, Französisch und Spanisch

SO VERBINDEN
1. Öffne Domora auf der Uhr und wähle QR-Code scannen.
2. Scanne den Code mit der Kamera des Telefons. Gib auf der Seite, die sich öffnet, die Adresse deines Home Assistant ein und melde dich dort an.
3. Die Uhr meldet Gekoppelt. Wähle Favoriten wählen und suche deine Geräte aus.

Lieber von Hand? Öffne in der Connect IQ-App auf dem Telefon die Einstellungen von Domora und trage die https-Adresse deines Home Assistant ein (zum Beispiel https://mein-zuhause.example:8123, ein Port ist in Ordnung) sowie ein langlebiges Zugangstoken (Home Assistant: dein Profil, Sicherheit, Langlebige Zugangstoken, Token erstellen).

WAS ES BRAUCHT
- Home Assistant 2023.4 oder neuer, aus dem Internet über HTTPS mit gültigem Zertifikat erreichbar (Home Assistant Cloud oder eigene Domain). Einfaches http und selbst signierte Zertifikate funktionieren auf Garmin-Uhren nicht
- Dein Telefon in der Nähe mit Bluetooth an; die Uhr erreicht dein Zuhause über die Garmin-Connect-App
- Datenschutz: Beim Koppeln per QR-Code erstellt die Seite auf dem Telefon in deinem Home Assistant ein Zugangstoken namens Domora watch und gibt es verschlüsselt an die Uhr weiter. Der Schlüssel entsteht auf der Uhr, reist nur im QR-Code zum Telefon und erreicht nie einen Server. Der Relay-Server hält nur die verschlüsselte Nachricht, höchstens 10 Minuten, und löscht sie, sobald die Uhr sie abgeholt hat. Danach bleibt das Token auf der Uhr und wird nur an deinen eigenen Home Assistant gesendet

Domora ist eine unabhängige App und steht in keiner Verbindung zu Home Assistant oder der Open Home Foundation.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: Listen scrollen jetzt mit dem nativen Scrollen deiner Uhr. Schalter und Szenen schaltest du direkt in der Liste; Lampen und Ventilatoren öffnen ihren Ring-Bildschirm. Geräte, Entitäten oder Bereiche mit dem Label „garmin“ in Home Assistant erscheinen automatisch in den Favoriten.

appLocalizations.name: Domora - Télécommande pour Home Assistant
appLocalizations.description:
Domora est une télécommande pour Home Assistant sur votre montre. Vos appareils favoris sont à un appui : lumières, interrupteurs, thermostat, volets, serrures, lecteurs média, scènes et capteurs.

Aucun fichier à écrire, aucun groupe à ajouter dans configuration.yaml. Vous scannez avec le téléphone un code QR affiché sur la montre, vous vous connectez à votre Home Assistant, et la montre est reliée. Vous choisissez ensuite vos favoris sur la montre, par pièce ou par type. Une maison de démonstration permet de tout essayer d'abord.

CE QU'ELLE FAIT
- Page de favoris avec de grands boutons ; un bouton allumé signifie que l'appareil est en marche. Le premier favori est plus grand : ouvrez l'app et appuyez une fois
- Choix des favoris sur la montre par pièce ou par type, ordre et suppression, sans fichier de configuration
- Pièces : chaque pièce avec ses appareils, chargée par petits lots pour que les grandes maisons fonctionnent aussi
- Scènes : vos scènes et scripts, trouvés automatiquement
- Page de capteurs et un aperçu avec une ou deux valeurs de votre choix, actualisé en arrière-plan
- Lumières avec luminosité, ventilateurs avec vitesse, thermostats avec consigne et mode, volets avec ouvrir, arrêter et fermer, lecteurs média avec volume, pause et suivant
- Serrures et alarmes : déverrouiller et désarmer demandent toujours une confirmation
- Aussi : entrées booléennes, nombres et listes, aspirateurs, automatisations et boutons
- Le bouton réagit tout de suite, puis Domora relit l'état réel de votre maison
- S'ouvre immédiatement avec le dernier état connu et s'actualise pendant que vous regardez
- Des messages clairs en cas de problème (jeton refusé, HTTPS requis, pas de téléphone, pas de réponse), chacun avec la marche à suivre
- Fonctionne au toucher et avec les boutons seuls
- Français, anglais, néerlandais, allemand et espagnol

COMMENT CONNECTER
1. Ouvrez Domora sur la montre et choisissez Scanner le code QR.
2. Scannez le code avec l'appareil photo du téléphone. Sur la page qui s'ouvre, saisissez l'adresse de votre Home Assistant et connectez-vous.
3. La montre indique Associé. Choisissez Choisir des favoris et prenez vos appareils.

Vous préférez le faire à la main ? Dans l'app Connect IQ du téléphone, ouvrez les réglages de Domora et saisissez l'adresse https de votre Home Assistant (par exemple https://ma-maison.example:8123, un port est accepté) et un jeton d'accès longue durée (Home Assistant : votre profil, Sécurité, Jetons d'accès longue durée, Créer un jeton).

CE QU'IL FAUT
- Home Assistant 2023.4 ou plus récent, joignable depuis Internet en HTTPS avec un certificat valide (Home Assistant Cloud ou votre propre domaine). Le simple http et les certificats auto-signés ne fonctionnent pas sur les montres Garmin
- Votre téléphone à proximité, Bluetooth activé ; la montre atteint votre maison par l'app Garmin Connect
- Confidentialité : avec l'association par code QR, la page du téléphone crée dans votre Home Assistant un jeton d'accès nommé Domora watch et le transmet chiffré à la montre. La clé est créée sur la montre, ne voyage que dans le code QR vers votre téléphone et n'atteint jamais un serveur. Le serveur relais ne conserve que le message chiffré, 10 minutes au plus, et le supprime dès que la montre l'a récupéré. Ensuite le jeton reste sur la montre et n'est envoyé qu'à votre propre Home Assistant

Domora est une application indépendante, sans lien avec Home Assistant ni l'Open Home Foundation.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: Les listes défilent désormais avec le défilement natif de la montre. appLocalizations.name: Domora - Mando para Home Assistant
appLocalizations.description:
Domora es un mando para Home Assistant en tu reloj. Tus dispositivos favoritos están a un toque: luces, interruptores, termostato, persianas, cerraduras, reproductores, escenas y sensores.

No hay que escribir ningún archivo ni añadir un grupo a configuration.yaml. Escaneas con el teléfono un código QR en el reloj, inicias sesión en tu Home Assistant y el reloj queda conectado. Después eliges tus favoritos en el propio reloj, por habitación o por tipo. Una casa de demostración te deja probarlo todo primero.

QUÉ HACE
- Página de favoritos con botones grandes; un botón iluminado significa que el dispositivo está encendido. El primer favorito es más grande: abre la app y toca una vez
- Elegir favoritos en el reloj por área o por tipo, ordenarlos y quitarlos, sin archivo de configuración
- Áreas: cada habitación con sus dispositivos, cargada poco a poco para que también funcionen las casas grandes
- Escenas: tus escenas y scripts, encontrados automáticamente
- Página de sensores y un vistazo con uno o dos valores que tú eliges, actualizado en segundo plano
- Luces con brillo, ventiladores con velocidad, termostatos con temperatura objetivo y modo, persianas con abrir, parar y cerrar, reproductores con volumen, pausa y siguiente
- Cerraduras y alarmas: desbloquear y desarmar siempre piden confirmación
- También: booleanos, números y listas de entrada, aspiradoras, automatizaciones y botones
- El botón reacciona al instante y después Domora lee el estado real de tu casa
- Se abre al momento con el último estado conocido y se actualiza mientras miras
- Mensajes claros cuando algo falla (token rechazado, se necesita HTTPS, sin teléfono, sin respuesta), cada uno con lo que hay que hacer
- Funciona con pantalla táctil y solo con botones
- Español, inglés, neerlandés, alemán y francés

CÓMO CONECTAR
1. Abre Domora en el reloj y elige Escanear código QR.
2. Escanea el código con la cámara del teléfono. En la página que se abre, escribe la dirección de tu Home Assistant e inicia sesión.
3. El reloj indica Vinculado. Elige Elegir favoritos y escoge tus dispositivos.

¿Prefieres hacerlo a mano? En la app Connect IQ del teléfono, abre los ajustes de Domora e introduce la dirección https de tu Home Assistant (por ejemplo https://mi-casa.example:8123, se admite un puerto) y un token de acceso de larga duración (Home Assistant: tu perfil, Seguridad, Tokens de acceso de larga duración, Crear token).

QUÉ NECESITA
- Home Assistant 2023.4 o posterior, accesible desde internet por HTTPS con un certificado válido (Home Assistant Cloud o tu propio dominio). El http simple y los certificados autofirmados no funcionan en relojes Garmin
- Tu teléfono cerca con el Bluetooth activado; el reloj llega a tu casa a través de la app Garmin Connect
- Privacidad: al vincular con el código QR, la página del teléfono crea en tu Home Assistant un token de acceso llamado Domora watch y lo pasa cifrado al reloj. La clave se crea en el reloj, solo viaja dentro del código QR hasta tu teléfono y nunca llega a un servidor. El servidor de paso guarda solo el mensaje cifrado, como máximo 10 minutos, y lo borra en cuanto el reloj lo recoge. Después el token se queda en tu reloj y solo se envía a tu propio Home Assistant

Domora es una app independiente, sin relación con Home Assistant ni con la Open Home Foundation.
appLocalizations.whatsNew: Las listas ahora usan el desplazamiento nativo del reloj. Interruptores y escenas se activan directamente desde la lista; luces y ventiladores abren su pantalla de anillo. Los dispositivos, entidades o áreas con la etiqueta "garmin" en Home Assistant aparecen automáticamente en Favoritos.

appLocalizations.name: Musicstand Metronome
appLocalizations.description:
A simple, accurate metronome on your wrist, with beep, vibration or both.

  Practice with a click you can feel. Set the tempo, pick a time signature, and the watch counts out every beat with a tone, a buzz, or both. Beat 1
  of each bar is accented, so you never lose your place, even in vibration-only mode.

  FEATURES
  • Tempo from 20 to 300 BPM, with the Italian tempo name shown (Largo, Andante, Allegro, Presto…)
  • Beep, Buzz or Beep+Buzz output
  • Time signatures: 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4 and 6/8, with an accented downbeat (a higher tone and a longer, stronger buzz)
  • Subdivisions: 8ths, triplets or 16ths, played as lighter clicks between the beats
  • Tap tempo: tap along to a song and the tempo is set for you
  • Up to 8 presets that save tempo, time signature and subdivision together
  • While running, the screen shows one dot per beat of the bar, the bar number and the elapsed time
  • The screen edge flashes on every beat (white on the downbeat)
  • Steady timing: beats are scheduled against the watch clock, so the tempo doesn't drift over a long session
  • Remembers your last settings

  TOUCHSCREEN WATCHES
  • Tap − / + to change by 1 BPM, or swipe up/down for ±5
  • Tap the number to choose a tempo from a list
  • Top left: sound. Top right: time signature
  • Left of START: subdivision. Right of START: presets
  • Tap the bottom of the screen for tap tempo

  BUTTON WATCHES
  On-screen hints sit beside the buttons they belong to:
  • UP / DOWN: +1 / −1 BPM
  • START: start and stop
  • Hold UP (menu): set BPM, tap tempo, sound, time signature, subdivision and presets
  • BACK: exit

  GOOD TO KNOW
  • If the screen shows "Tones off in settings" or "Vibe off in settings", turn on alert tones or vibration in your watch's system settings.
  • Some watches have no speaker; use Buzz mode on those.
  • Watch apps only run while open, so keep the metronome on screen while you practice. It keeps going with the screen dimmed.
  • At very fast tempos with 16th-note subdivisions, the in-between vibrations are short and may be hard to feel.

  No account, no permissions, and no data collected. It's just a metronome.

  Ideas or problems? Leave a review or contact the developer through the store.

appLocalizations.name: Tea Timer

Brew every tea right, from your wrist.

Pick a tea, set your water volume: Tea Timer suggests the dose, reminds you of the water temperature and times the steeping, with a little 8-bit cup that brews along.

• Built-in catalogues: about 30 Dammann Frères teas and 40 Mariage Frères teas (including the whole Sakura range), with each house's water temperature and steeping time
• The dose follows your water volume; use more or less tea and the time adjusts within the house's recommended range
• Heating screen with the target temperature ("do not boil" for delicate teas)
• Countdown with a progress ring and an 8-bit cup whose tea darkens as it brews; pause and resume with a tap
• End-of-brew alert: 6 vibration patterns you can try on the watch, 1 to 5 alerts, sound on or off
• Default water volume and your settings remembered for each tea
• My teas: add up to 20 of your own teas in the app settings (Garmin Connect)
• Follows your watch units: °C or °F, centilitres or fluid ounces

Temperatures and times come from the houses' product pages. Dammann Frères does not publish a dose per tea: 2 g per 20 cl is used (2.5 g for white teas and herbal infusions).

Not affiliated with Dammann Frères or Mariage Frères nor Palais des Thés

appLocalizations.description:
Réussissez chaque thé, depuis votre poignet.

appLocalizations.name: Kayapp - Canoe & kayak activity tracker
appLocalizations.description:
KayApp - Il tuo compagno di allenamento per Kayak e Canoa Canadese
Porta i tuoi allenamenti in acqua al livello successivo con KayApp, l'applicazione progettata specificamente per gli atleti e gli appassionati di kayak e canoa canadese. Trasforma il tuo dispositivo Garmin in un computer di bordo completo e intuitivo, pensato per monitorare ogni singola pagaiata.
Caratteristiche principali:
• Metriche specifiche per la pagaiata: Visualizza in tempo reale la frequenza di pagaiata (colpi al minuto), la distanza per singolo colpo e l'efficienza di avanzamento.
• Dati GPS e Velocità avanzati: Monitora velocità istantanea, velocità media, passo (min/km o min/500m) e distanza totale percorsa.
• Gestione degli allenamenti: Ideale sia per le uscite di resistenza su lunga distanza sia per le sessioni di ripetute e intervalli ad alta intensità.
• Schermate chiare e leggibili: Interfaccia ottimizzata per una lettura rapida anche in movimento, sotto il sole o con schizzi d'acqua.
• Analisi post-allenamento: Sincronizza automaticamente i tuoi dati con Garmin Connect per rivedere tracce GPS, grafici della cadenza, zone cardio e progressi nel tempo.
Che tu stia preparando una gara di velocità, una maratona fluviale o semplicemente godendoti un'uscita sul lago, KayApp ti offre tutti i dati di cui hai bisogno direttamente al polso.
