appLocalizations.name: RYVOLVE: Hybrid Training
appLocalizations.description:
Your RYVOLVE hybrid training plan, on your wrist.

RYVOLVE builds your plan around running, lifting and stations. Today's session waits on your watch, so you can train with your phone in your bag.

What you get
- Today's session on your watch, ready when you are. Nothing records until you press START.
- Every set, rep, weight and station logged as you go.
- Runs with your target pace and distance.
- Timed holds and rest timers that keep the session moving.
- Your result the moment you finish, saved to RYVOLVE and to Garmin Connect.
- Start on your watch or on your phone. If your phone is with you, it follows along.

No phone app needed to start
- Quick start on the watch: a run, a full HYROX sim or a half HYROX sim, free, with no account.
- HYROX sims use the official Open weights for you, from your Garmin profile.

Your full plan
- Your personal training plan needs the RYVOLVE app for iPhone and a RYVOLVE subscription. RYVOLVE is free to try.
- RYVOLVE is on iPhone only for now.

Questions? Email support@ryvolveapp.com.
Privacy: ryvolveapp.com/privacy
appLocalizations.whatsNew: First release. Your RYVOLVE sessions now run on your Garmin watch, and anyone can start a run or a HYROX sim straight from the watch.

appLocalizations.name: Linux Server Status
appLocalizations.description:
Server Status puts your Linux server’s vital stats on your Garmin watch. Check CPU utilization, RAM and root disk usage, uptime, and the age of the last reading.

On compatible watches, the glance shows the last CPU and RAM readings. Select it to open the full dashboard and fetch a fresh reading. The dashboard refreshes every minute by default while open. You can change the interval in Connect IQ settings or press GPS/START to refresh immediately. Give your server a name to recognize it in the glance and dashboard.

Setup
1. Download the Linux installer and run sh setup.sh on your server:

wget https://github.com/Asparaguss/garmin-server-status/releases/latest/download/setup.sh && sh setup.sh

2. Run: sudo sh install.sh show-token from the extracted installer folder to display your HTTPS endpoint and read-only token. If you have the qrencode package installed on your server, you can show the token as QR code.

3. Enter the endpoint and token in the app’s Connect IQ settings (I recommend saving it in a password manager or scanning it with your phone before).

The self-hosted service supports native and Docker Caddy setups. The watch fetches readings over HTTPS through Garmin Connect on your paired phone.

appLocalizations.name: Training Status
appLocalizations.description:
Training Status – Independent Estimate

Training status and glance for compatible Garmin watches. English interface with status-colored backgrounds.

Displays Productive, Unproductive, Overreaching, Peaking, Maintaining, Recovery and Detraining using an independent VO2 trend and ATL/CTL model. Includes VO2 history, estimated HRV classification, load balance and sync diagnostics.

Requires your own Intervals.icu account and personal API key for cloud features. Configure the key in the Connect IQ phone app settings. Supported watches also offer entry under Intervals.icu setup, then select Sync now. No API key is included. Data availability depends on your account and connected services. Missing or stale data may prevent a status being calculated. Background sync timing is controlled by the watch and requires connectivity.

VO2 trend needs two distinct measurement days in each of two seven-day windows, spanning at least seven days; the latest measurement must be no older than seven days. HRV classification needs a personal history baseline.

This is an independent estimate, not Garmin's native Training Status or Firstbeat algorithm. HRV classification is estimated from imported history. The app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin or Intervals.icu. It is not a medical device.

Data handling: the app sends authenticated HTTPS requests to Intervals.icu and stores credentials and downloaded history locally in Connect IQ application storage. It does not send data to a developer-operated server or include advertising/analytics. Users can disconnect their account in the app and revoke the key at Intervals.icu.
